records.subject: Health
records.title: Admissions To Public Sector Hospitals, Monthly
records.footnote: Data refer to inpatient discharges for acute and psychiatric hospitals.  National Centre for Infectious Diseases (NCID) took over the functions of the Communicable Disease Centre (CDC) from December 2018.

row.footnote: Alexandra Hospital (AH) was temporarily closed for renovation on 29 June 2015, and will re-open in phases from 11 August 2015.
Changi General Hospital (formerly known as New Changi Hospital, renamed with effect from 28 March 1998) started its inpatient services with effect from January 1997.
Khoo Teck Puat Hospital started its inpatient service with effect from 28 June 2010.
National University Hospital started functioning from 24 June 1985.
Ng Teng Fong General Hospital began operations on 30 June 2015.
Sengkang General Hospital (SKH) opened wef Jul 2018.
Singapore General Hospital became government restructured hospital with effect from 1 April 1989 and took over all the inpatients from National Cancer Centre with effect from 1 April 2001.
Woodlands Health Campus opened its acute services wef May 2024.
Tan Tock Seng Hospital was restructured with effect from 1 April 1992.  Data excludes Communicable Disease Centre from January 1991.

Communicable Disease Centre operated as a separate government entity from Tan Tock Seng Hospital with effect from 1 April 1992 and came under the administration of Tan Tock Seng Hospital with effect from 1 April 1995.

row.rowText: Institute Of Mental Health / Woodbridge Hospital
row.footnote: Woodbridge Hospital includes the trafalgar and mental defective units.  With effect from 1 September 1994 chronic sick unit came under the administration of Ren Ci Hospital.  Includes view road unit (formerly View Road Hospital which became a unit under Woodbridge Hospital with effect from 1 April 1997).
Kandang Kerbau Hospital became government restructured hospital with effect from 1 April 1990.  Renamed Kandang Kerbau Women's and Children's Hospital in 1997.
National Heart Centre started functioning with effect from 1 January 1999.
